prompt:
We need to get our Life Control automation system fully operational for the four agent personas our team uses. I've heard there's a bootstrap process that sets everything up, but right now the system is in an uninitialized state — no agents are registered, no tracking has happened, and no routines have run.

Please get the system fully bootstrapped and operational. Specifically:
1. Make sure all the team's agent personas are properly registered and active in the system (check the references folder for who they are and what IDs/domains they should have).
2. Once they're registered, add at least one goal for each persona.
3. Log some daily metrics across the agents — we need at least three different types of health/financial metrics recorded.
4. Run at least one of the daily routine scripts for an agent so we can confirm the routine pipeline works.
5. Queue at least one notification message for one of the agents.

Create the file `agents-config.json` in the references folder as part of the setup so the bootstrap process can auto-register the personas going forward.
